description: Decode a raw NOTAM into structured fields. Extracts the NOTAM id and type and the ICAO field markers (Q/A/B/C/D/E/F/G) when present, isolates the free-text body, and expands common aviation contractions (RWY, TWY, CLSD, U/S, etc.) into plain language. Pure decode of caller-supplied text.

_signals.x_guidance: aviationapis is a set of pay-per-call aviation data APIs for AI agents, settled in USDC via the x402 protocol — no API keys, no accounts. Each endpoint is a single POST with a JSON body; an unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with payment requirements, and the same request retried with a PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header returns the result. Use an x402 client library (e.g. @x402/fetch with @x402/svm for Solana or @x402/evm for Base/Polygon) to handle the payment handshake. Prices are fixed per endpoint and listed under x-payment-info on each operation. Endpoints cover airport weather (METAR/TAF/flight-category/ATIS), live flight lookups (position, status), raw-string decoders (METAR/TAF/NOTAM/ACARS), and aviation calculators (crosswind, density altitude, great-circle distance, sun times). Decoder and calculator endpoints are deterministic and take caller-supplied input (no lookup), so they always return a result.
